vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: it-risk-assessment-tool
Version: 1.3.0

The skill is a functional IT risk assessment tool designed to evaluate organizational security maturity across six domains. It collects user-provided maturity levels and transmits them via a standard curl command to a documented API endpoint (portal.toolweb.in) to generate a risk report. While the data handled is sensitive (security posture), the behavior is transparent, aligned with the stated purpose, and lacks indicators of malicious intent, unauthorized data exfiltration, or hidden command execution.

llm.summary: The skill's requests and runtime instructions are consistent with an API-driven IT risk assessment: it legitimately requires curl and a TOOLWEB_API_KEY to POST user-provided control ratings to portal.toolweb.in, but using it will transmit whatever assessment details you provide to an external service so you should avoid sending secrets or sensitive operational data.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (IT risk assessment) match the behavior in SKILL.md: gather control maturity ratings from the user and POST them to https://portal.toolweb.in/apis/security/it-risk-assessment. Requiring TOOLWEB_API_KEY and curl is proportionate to an external-API-based assessment. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to ask the user for maturity ratings and then call the toolweb API with those values and a generated sessionId. The instructions do not tell the agent to read local files or other environment variables beyond TOOLWEB_API_KEY. Important caveat: any free-text input from the user (including hostnames, architecture details, or accidentally pasted credentials) will be forwarded to the external API — so this is a potential data-exposure vector that the user should manage.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files (instruction-only). That minimizes on-disk code risk. The only runtime dependency declared is curl, which is reasonable for making the described HTTP request.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single environment variable (TOOLWEB_API_KEY) is required and it's declared as the primary credential. That aligns with the skill's need to authenticate to the external API. No unrelated secrets or multiple credential sets are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true, does not require installing background services, and does not ask to modify other skills or system-wide settings. Model invocation is permitted (default), which is expected for an interactive skill.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for its stated purpose, but it sends whatever you type to portal.toolweb.in. Do not paste real credentials, private keys, detailed hostnames/IPs, or screenshots containing secrets into the assessment inputs. Before using in production: (1) verify the vendor (portal.toolweb.in) and its privacy/security policy, (2) create an API key with limited scope and the ability to revoke it, (3) test using non-sensitive or synthetic data first, (4) monitor API usage and network egress, and (5) rotate/revoke the API key if you see unexpected activity. If you need assessments that must not leave your environment, prefer a local/offline tool instead.
